reason: Momentum/swing long setups on daily bars using VCP breakouts, pocket pivots and MA pullbacks with explicit risk rules.

universe.description: Australian equities primary; also US stocks

setup.quote: I have the volatility contraction pattern which is from Mark Manini. ... that's effectively a breakout trade.
I use a pocket pivot which comes from Gil Morales ... the stock needs to come from below the 10day moving average to close above it on that volume.
a pullback buy method where the stock is already trending. ... buying off the first pullback to the moving average when it's obeyed on the uptick.

entry.rule: Buy above pivot after contraction; no chase >4%
entry.quote: I'll just set my alert above that little pivot point. And when that goes through there, I'm buying. ... if it goes 4% past there, that's it's off the table.

entry.rule: Wait for higher close on pullback
entry.quote: I'm waiting for the next day for the close or for the intraday to be above that previous day's high.

stop.rule: Initial stop below base; move to breakeven at +10%
stop.quote: Ideally, I want to move my stop to break even as soon as possible. So, if I'm up 10% in a trade, I'll just try to reduce my risk immediately.

exits.rule: Partial sell at +20% gain; trail 20-day EMA
exits.quote: if I'm risking 1 in and which might be 5% and all of a sudden I make 20% I'll definitely be selling partial into that ... to get out, I'll use a moving average. ... holding the 20-day

sizing.rule: Initial position <=8%, max 20% concentrated; risk ~1% per trade
sizing.quote: I don't like to trade more than 8% in a position. ... I will go up to 20% into one stock. ... if you're taking a 10% position size, your risk with a 10% stop is 1% of your total capital.

market_filter.rule: Follow leadership; go to cash on distribution in leaders
market_filter.quote: my system works very much on following leadership. ... If the market comes under distribution ... I went back to cash.

ambiguities.issue: Exact momentum_lookback_days, consolidation_days, consolidation_max_range_pct not stated numerically
ambiguities.assumption: VCP implies multi-week contraction with tightening ranges per Minervini description
partial sell after ~20% gain, fraction unspecified
